title: 高销售低毛利商品诊断
context: 商品经理不希望销售额掩盖利润问题。
requirements: 2025年线下商品净销售额位于前四分之一且毛利率低于30%；返回销售、毛利率、折扣额、退款额；按净销售降序、商品编号升序。四分位使用NTILE(4)，并列按编号。
commonError: 先按毛利筛选再计算销售四分位改变总体。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost,SUM(discount_cents) discount,SUM(refund_cents) refund FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id), b AS (SELECT *,NTILE(4) OVER(ORDER BY net DESC,product_id) bucket FROM a) SELECT product_id,net net_cents,ROUND(100.0*(net-cost)/NULLIF(net,0),2) margin_pct,discount discount_cents,refund refund_cents FROM b WHERE bucket=1 AND 100.0*(net-cost)/NULLIF(net,0)<30 ORDER BY net DESC,product_id
